summary: Full backend + frontend verification of 4 features: (1) ENFORCE_ADMIN_2FA flow (login/setup/enable/verify/disable/regenerate/recovery codes), (2) PREVIEW env badge in topbar, (3) One-click 'Pay Now' Vendor → Expenses pre-fill, (4) Accountant Pack ZIP download. 12/12 backend pytest cases PASS; all 5 frontend flows verified via Playwright. No critical issues.

minor.issue: NestJS returns 201 Created for these POSTs (no @HttpCode(200) decorator). Backend works correctly but spec uses '200' verbiage. Frontend axios treats 2xx the same so no functional impact. Optional cleanup: add @HttpCode(200) for consistency with login + login-verify.
Manifest/README files are named MANIFEST-{year}.csv and README-{year}.txt (not bare MANIFEST.csv / README.txt). Functionally fine; tests adjusted to accept the prefix pattern.

issues: Date field uses browser-native <input type=date> picker rather than shadcn calendar component (per platform guidance preferring shadcn). Same applies anywhere else <input type=date> is used.

action_items: Optional: add @HttpCode(200) to /api/auth/2fa/setup, /enable, /disable, /recovery-codes/regenerate for HTTP semantic consistency.
Optional: rename ZIP entries to MANIFEST.csv / README.txt if external accountant tooling expects exact filenames (current names include year suffix).
Optional design: replace native date inputs in Expense modal with shadcn DatePicker for consistent UX.
critical_code_review_comments: two-fa.service.ts: setup() correctly clears two_fa_enabled, two_fa_recovery_codes, and overwrites two_fa_secret — verified by ensure_disabled helper behavior.
Recovery codes are bcrypt-hashed in storage and compared via bcrypt.compare; plain codes are uppercased and trimmed before hashing AND before verification — case-insensitive match works correctly.

Single-use recovery code enforcement: after successful consume, the code's hash is removed from the array — verified by test_login_verify_with_recovery_code_succeeds_and_is_single_use (second attempt returns 401).
Regenerate replaces the entire recovery_codes array, so previously unused old codes are properly invalidated — verified.
must_setup_2fa flag correctly derived from ENFORCE_ADMIN_2FA env + role='admin' + !two_fa_enabled — flips True/False appropriately across setup → enable → disable lifecycle.
Frontend AppLayout renders env-badge twice (desktop topbar + mobile header). Both with same data-testid='env-badge' — use .first or .nth(0) in tests; not a bug but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one TEST_PayVendor for vendor-pay flow validation. Final DB state restored: 2FA disabled, TEST vendor cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin account starts each session with 2FA DISABLED (must_setup_2fa=true). To navigate past /setup-2fa gate during UI testing, either complete the 2FA enrollment in-flow OR use API: POST /api/auth/2fa/setup → POST /api/auth/2fa/enable with pyotp.TOTP(secret).now(). Always disable 2FA at end of suite. Use 'python -c "import pyotp; print(pyotp.TOTP(SECRET).now())"' for fresh codes. Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_2fa_and_accountant_pack_iter20.py is idempotent and self-cleans.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two minor observations: (a) NestJS POSTs return 201 not 200 (functional, just status code semantics); (b) ZIP filenames include year suffix (MANIFEST-2026.csv) instead of plain MANIFEST.csv — both non-breaking.
